_about: 2026 年 1–6 月全球均温是否高于任何往年同期的冻结证据包。信息截至 2026-06-30。

evidence.title: Copernicus: Fifth-warmest January sees 2026 start with weather extremes
evidence.excerpt: January 2026 was the fifth-warmest January globally, with an average surface air temperature of 12.95°C, 0.51°C above the 1991-2020 average for January, according to the ERA5 data
evidence.claim: 截点前的官方月报显示 2026 年 1 月并非同期最热。

evidence.title: Surface air temperature for February 2026
evidence.excerpt: February 2026 was the fifth-warmest February globally
evidence.claim: 官方月报显示 2026 年 2 月为历史第 5 暖。

evidence.title: Copernicus: Second-highest surface air and sea surface temperatures for May globally
evidence.excerpt: May 2026 was the second warmest on record globally across land and sea
evidence.claim: 官方月报显示 2026 年 5 月为历史第 2 暖，未创同期新高。
